descriptions.HTML: Builds the semantic structure of web pages, helping browsers and assistive technologies understand content.
descriptions.C: Used for low-level systems and embedded software where direct hardware control and predictable performance matter.
descriptions.CSS: Creates responsive layouts and visual styles that adapt web interfaces to different screens and devices.
descriptions.Xcode: Apple's development environment for building, testing, and debugging apps for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
descriptions.Python: Commonly used for automation, backend services, data processing, and machine-learning prototypes.
descriptions.Java: An object-oriented language used in backend services, enterprise applications, and Android software.
descriptions.C++: Supports performance-sensitive applications such as game engines, systems software, and embedded products.
descriptions.C#: Used to build Unity games and applications on the .NET platform.
descriptions.MATLAB: Helps engineers and researchers analyze data, model systems, and run numerical simulations.
descriptions.JavaScript: Adds interaction to websites and also powers server-side applications through runtimes such as Node.js.

descriptions.Git: Tracks code changes and supports collaborative development through branches, reviews, and merges.
descriptions.Visual Studio: An IDE for developing and debugging .NET, C++, and other desktop or service applications.
descriptions.MySQL: A relational database used to store structured application data and query it with SQL.
descriptions.Wireshark: Captures and inspects network traffic to troubleshoot connectivity and understand protocols.
descriptions.Docker: Packages applications and their dependencies into containers for consistent development and deployment.
descriptions.Command Line: Runs shell commands for navigating projects, automating tasks, and building software.
descriptions.Arduino IDE: Writes and uploads firmware for Arduino-compatible microcontrollers and connected hardware.
descriptions.DaVinci Resolve: Edits video and handles color correction, audio, and post-production workflows.
descriptions.Unity: A real-time engine for creating interactive 2D and 3D applications, including games.

descriptions.Web Development: Combines frontend interfaces, server logic, and APIs to deliver complete browser-based products.
descriptions.Agentic Workflow: Connects AI models with tools and structured steps to automate multi-stage tasks with checks.
descriptions.Large Language Models: Generative AI models that can interpret and produce text for assistants, analysis, and automation.
descriptions.Databases: Covers data modeling, schema design, queries, and reliable storage for application information.
descriptions.Object-Oriented Programming: Organizes software around reusable objects and clear responsibilities between components.
descriptions.Hardware-Software Integration: Connects firmware and application code with sensors, circuits, and physical devices.
descriptions.Prototyping: Turns early requirements into testable models to validate usability and technical assumptions quickly.

descriptions.English (Native): Native English communication for technical collaboration, documentation, and stakeholder discussions.
descriptions.Spanish (Fluent): Fluent Spanish communication for collaboration with Spanish-speaking users and teams.
